text:
maria.v: FYI — Acme reported a weird billing vs dashboard gap. Invoice shows 14.7M tokens for 2026-04-20..21 (INV-8432) but the project usage tile for project `acme-website` only shows ~12.4M. They also hit 429s around 16:30 UTC yesterday despite the tile showing capacity. Can we triage?

support-bot: Automated note: please include org_id, project_id, sample request_ids, and invoice pdf for faster triage.

maria.v: Org: `acme-inc` (org_9123), project: `acme-website` (proj_77). Attached invoice link: https://billing.redwood.internal/invoices/INV-8432 (internal). Sample request-id: `req_20260420_163245_ab12`.

devon: thanks. quick sanity checks: 1) are we sure invoice is billed to same billing account (some customers have multiple)? 2) dashboard tiles are 24h rolling windows (UTC) vs invoice uses calendar grouping by billing day — might cause ~1-day offset. Did they run any backfills/embeddings last week?

maria.v: They did a nightly embed job Apr 20 02:00 UTC for ~2.5M tokens (search index). That job uses the org default project; billing contact says it should be on `acme-website` though.

oliver.billing: Rapid note from finance: invoices are charged at the billing-account level and include everything billed to the account (org-level pools + default project assignments). If the nightly job used the org default project (not the app project) tokens may be attributed differently in the dashboard view. That could explain +2.3M.

ingrid.engineering: For the 429s: the enforcement is at two layers — project quota and org shared pool. If org pool is depleted or has a lower burst threshold, projects can see 429s even when their project tile hasn't hit its local quota. Can you share the timeline for the 429s?

maria.v: 429s between 16:28 and 16:35 UTC. Client reports ~60 rps sustained, many short requests. Project quota is 100 rps. Project tile at that time shows steady usage ~55 rps.

devon: That matches org pool exhaustion. We had a bursty partner job in another project yesterday around 16:20 that consumed shared pool capacity for ~10m. If that job was billed to the same billing account, invoice will include it but the `acme-website` tile won't show it.

maria.v: Ok. I pulled metering events for the window and pasted a small snippet:
```
2026-04-20T16:19:03Z meter_event { org_id: org_9123 project: proj_71 tokens: 3_200_400 }
2026-04-20T16:21:47Z meter_event { org_id: org_9123 project: proj_77 tokens: 12_345 }
2026-04-20T16:28:10Z meter_event { org_id: org_9123 project: proj_77 tokens: 45_600 request_id: req_20260420_163245_ab12 }
2026-04-20T16:29:58Z meter_event { org_id: org_9123 project: proj_71 tokens: 2_100_000 }
```

oliver.billing: From finance side I'll reconcile invoice lines vs ledger. If meter events show proj_71 consumed 3.2M at 16:19 and 2.1M at 16:29 that's ~5.3M which could account for the invoice delta vs the single-project tile.

ingrid.engineering: Actionable checklist: 1) engineering to verify that dashboard tile `project usage` is filtering only project-id events (not org-default assignments). 2) infra to confirm rolling window alignment between dashboards and billing summaries (UTC vs billing-day). 3) support to collect 3 sample request_ids and the invoice pdf from customer.

devon: quick query you can run internally to verify ledger rollup: `SELECT project, SUM(tokens) FROM token_ledger WHERE org_id='org_9123' AND ts BETWEEN '2026-04-20T00:00:00Z' AND '2026-04-21T00:00:00Z' GROUP BY project ORDER BY 2 DESC;` should show proj_71 and proj_77 numbers that sum to invoice-level total.

maria.v: I'll run that and upload results to the ticket. Also forwarding the invoice PDF now.

support-bot: Created INC-9284: "Billing/usage mismatch for acme-inc — invoice vs project tile". Assigned to ingrid.engineering, oliver.billing. ETA 48h for initial reconciliation.

ingrid.engineering: I'll validate dashboard filters and the quota enforcement logs for 16:25-16:35. If org-pool enforcement caused 429s we can document behavior and suggest adjusting burst policy or moving heavy background jobs to a separate billing account/project.

oliver.billing: Finance will produce a line-item reconciliation and reply in INC-9284 by EOD tomorrow. If there's misattribution we may need a credit or corrected invoice.

maria.v: Thank you everyone. I'll communicate to Acme that we're investigating, and that 429s + billing delta are likely related to cross-project org pool usage and a nightly embed job. Will update after query results. :eyes:

devon: one more note — ask Acme to confirm whether their background embed job explicitly set a `project_id` header or used the org default key. Many SDKs default to org config and that causes surprises.

maria.v: noted. I'll ask them and add to INC-9284.

oliver.billing: tagging @finance-ops for awareness.

maria.v: cc @acme-support (on customer side) — we'll follow up within 48h with reconciliation and recommended remediations.

support-bot: Thread closed by support-bot after assignment.
